class LRUCache:
    """A class that implements an LRU Cache using a dictionary for O(1) access and a doubly linked list for efficient ordering."""

    class Node:
        """A class to represent a node in the doubly linked list."""
        def __init__(self, key, value):
            self.key = key
            self.value = value
            self.prev = None
            self.next = None

    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.cache = {}
        self.head = self.Node(0, 0)  # dummy head
        self.tail = self.Node(0, 0)  # dummy tail
        self.head.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = self.head

    def _remove(self, node: Node):
        """Remove a node from the linked list."""
        prev_node = node.prev
        next_node = node.next
        prev_node.next = next_node
        next_node.prev = prev_node

    def _add_to_front(self, node: Node):
        """Add a new node right after the dummy head."""
        node.next = self.head.next
        node.prev = self.head
        self.head.next.prev = node
        self.head.next = node

    def get(self, key: int) -> int:
        """Return the value of the key if it exists, else return -1."""
        if key in self.cache:
            node = self.cache[key]
            self._remove(node)
            self._add_to_front(node)
            return node.value
        else:
            return -1

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        """Insert or update the value of the key."""
        if key in self.cache:
            node = self.cache[key]
            self._remove(node)
            node.value = value
            self._add_to_front(node)
        else:
            if len(self.cache) >= self.capacity:
                # Remove the LRU from the cache and the linked list
                lru_node = self.tail.prev
                self._remove(lru_node)
                del self.cache[lru_node.key]
            new_node = self.Node(key, value)
            self.cache[key] = new_node
            self._add_to_front(new_node)

class LRUCache:
    """A class that implements an LRU Cache using a combination of a hash map and a circular doubly linked list for efficient data retrieval and management."""

    class Node:
        """A class to represent a node in a circular doubly linked list."""
        def __init__(self, key, value):
            self.key = key
            self.value = value
            self.prev = None
            self.next = None

    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.cache = {}
        self.head = self.Node(0, 0)  # Initialize the head node
        self.tail = self.Node(0, 0)  # Initialize the tail node
        self.head.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = self.head

    def _remove(self, node: Node):
        """Remove a node from the circular linked list."""
        prev_node = node.prev
        next_node = node.next
        prev_node.next = next_node
        next_node.prev = prev_node

    def _add_to_front(self, node: Node):
        """Add a new node right after head in the circular linked list."""
        node.next = self.head.next
        node.prev = self.head
        self.head.next.prev = node
        self.head.next = node

    def _move_to_front(self, node: Node):
        """Move an existing node to the front (right after head)."""
        self._remove(node)
        self._add_to_front(node)

    def get(self, key: int) -> int:
        """Return the value of the key if it exists, else return -1."""
        if key in self.cache:
            node = self.cache[key]
            self._move_to_front(node)
            return node.value
        return -1

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        """Insert or update the value of the key."""
        if key in self.cache:
            node = self.cache[key]
            node.value = value
            self._move_to_front(node)
        else:
            if len(self.cache) >= self.capacity:
                # Remove the least recently used node
                lru_node = self.tail.prev
                self._remove(lru_node)
                del self.cache[lru_node.key]
            new_node = self.Node(key, value)
            self.cache[key] = new_node
            self._add_to_front(new_node)

class LRUCache:
    """A class that implements an LRU Cache using a hash map and a circular doubly linked list for O(1) get and put operations."""

    class Node:
        """A class to represent a node in the circular doubly linked list."""
        def __init__(self, key, value):
            self.key = key
            self.value = value
            self.prev = None
            self.next = None

    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.cache = {}
        self.head = self.Node(0, 0)  # dummy head
        self.head.next = self.head
        self.head.prev = self.head

    def _remove(self, node: Node):
        """Remove a node from the circular linked list."""
        node.prev.next = node.next
        node.next.prev = node.prev

    def _add_to_front(self, node: Node):
        """Add a new node right after the dummy head in the circular linked list."""
        node.next = self.head.next
        node.prev = self.head
        self.head.next.prev = node
        self.head.next = node

    def _pop_tail(self):
        """Remove the last node from the circular linked list."""
        tail = self.head.prev
        self._remove(tail)
        return tail

    def get(self, key: int) -> int:
        """Return the value of the key if it exists, else return -1."""
        if key in self.cache:
            node = self.cache[key]
            self._remove(node)
            self._add_to_front(node)
            return node.value
        else:
            return -1

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        """Insert or update the value of the key."""
        if key in self.cache:
            node = self.cache[key]
            self._remove(node)
            node.value = value
            self._add_to_front(node)
        else:
            if len(self.cache) >= self.capacity:
                # Remove the LRU from the cache
                lru_node = self._pop_tail()
                del self.cache[lru_node.key]
            new_node = self.Node(key, value)
            self.cache[key] = new_node
            self._add_to_front(new_node)
